description: The plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, comparing different model variants across three evaluation metrics. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and uses a categorical scale displaying five specific configurations: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)", representing percentages on a linear scale with a visible range from 58 to 66 and tick marks at intervals of 2. The "Precision" metric is represented by a solid purple line with circular markers; it starts at 65.45 for the "Full model (Ours)", drops to its lowest point of 61.06 at "w/o Prompt", and then steadily increases across the remaining variants, reaching 62.22 at "w/o Augmentation", 64.06 at "w/o Attention", and ending at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "Recall" metric is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at its peak of 65.78 for the "Full model (Ours)", decreasing sharply to 59.64 at "w/o Prompt", rising to 63.75 at "w/o Augmentation", and then declining through 59.17 at "w/o Attention" to end at its lowest value of 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Finally, the "F1-score" metric is depicted by a solid brown line with circular markers, starting at a high of 65.56 for the "Full model (Ours)", falling to 60.16 at "w/o Prompt", increasing to 62.63 at "w/o Augmentation", and subsequently decreasing to 59.67 at "w/o Attention", concluding at its lowest point of 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
